observations: Many spread, dendritic platelets on 316L SS and PPAmF; fewer on BVLD-PPAmF and NO-PPAmF; a few round, unspread platelets on BVLD/NO-PPAmF
Adhered platelets ~32, 41, 15.5, 11 and 5 (x1e2 cell/mm2) on 316L SS, PPAmF, BVLD-PPAmF, NO-PPAmF, BVLD/NO-PPAmF
Platelet activation ~65, 74, 23, 18 and ~1% across the same five surfaces
Photographs: 316L SS and PPAmF tubes are filled by dark thrombus; BVLD-PPAmF and NO-PPAmF partly open; BVLD/NO-PPAmF lumen and foil nearly clean
SEM: dense fibrin network with trapped cells on 316L SS and PPAmF; platelets with little fibrin on BVLD-PPAmF; fibrin strands on NO-PPAmF; almost bare BVLD/NO-PPAmF
Occlusion ~58, 63, 10, 7.5 and 3% (316L SS, PPAmF, BVLD-PPAmF, NO-PPAmF, BVLD/NO-PPAmF)
Thrombus weight ~64, 73, 5, 4 and 2 mg across the same surfaces
Blood flow retained ~20, 17, 64, 68 and 90% of the initial value across the same surfaces
